title: Open and closed subsets of Spec R are the D(e) of unique idempotents
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. For every subset $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$ that is open and closed there is a unique idempotent $e\in R$ ($e^2=e$) with $U=D(e)=\{\mathfrak p: e\notin\mathfrak p\}$; conversely $D(e)$ is open and closed for every idempotent $e$ (its complement is $D(1-e)$). This gives a bijection between the idempotents of $R$ and the open and closed subsets of $\operatorname{Spec}R$.
